cozy.finance is a decentralized finance protocol that operates on public blockchains without intermediaries. cozy.finance provides on-chain protection and coverage services built on smart contracts.

Unslashed Finance is a decentralized finance protocol that operates on public blockchains without intermediaries. Unslashed Finance provides on-chain insurance coverage against smart contract failures built on smart contracts.

Risk Harbor is a decentralized finance protocol that operates on public blockchains without intermediaries. Risk Harbor provides on-chain coverage against smart contract risk built on smart contracts.

Rocket Pool is a decentralized finance protocol that operates on public blockchains without intermediaries. Rocket Pool provides liquid staking on the Ethereum blockchain built on smart contracts. Rocket Pool issues a liquid staking token, rETH, to users who stake ETH. Rocket Pool requires node operators to post collateral in RPL tokens.
